dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent features exhibit irregular, sinuous dark perimeters surrounding lighter golden-brown interiors. These perimeters form distinct closed 'O' shapes and semi-open 'C' shapes with a high-contrast, sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior border to the light inner core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate density of small, asymmetrical, solid low-intensity dark pixel clusters located in the inter-annuli spaces. These clusters are most concentrated along the mid-lateral line, lacking internal gradients and appearing as saturated dark spots against the lighter base fur color.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Connecting the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper lateral flank forms an obtuse scalene triangle. A separate group of four smaller, low-intensity blobs located posterior to the main pattern cluster forms an irregular quadrilateral relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, high-contrast boundary is visible where the uniform low-intensity (near-black) cephalic and cervical regions meet the complex patterned dorsal region. Five distinct, parallel high-intensity linear highlights are visible on the distal portion of the hind flipper, corresponding to the anatomical ridges of the digits.
